question: The year is 2022. I am at the National Air and Space Museum east of the Potomac River. I want to go to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF using the metro. I go in the wrong direction and end up at the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. How many metro stations am I away from my original destination if I don't change lines? Your answer should be a numerical integer value.

history.name: user
history.content: The year is 2022. I am at the National Air and Space Museum east of the Potomac River. I want to go to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF using the metro. I go in the wrong direction and end up at the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. How many metro stations am I away from my original destination if I don't change lines? Your answer should be a numerical integer value.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: We will determine the station closest to the National Air and Space Museum (east of the Potomac), identify the closest station to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF (likely National Airport), and find the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School. Then, using the 2022 WMATA map, we will count the number of stations between the school’s nearest station and National Airport without changing lines. Team: WebSurfer for web lookups, Assistant for computation, FileSurfer for any local map file.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: WebSurfer, please look up the closest Metro station to the National Air and Space Museum on the National Mall (east of the Potomac).

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Search results indicate the National Air and Space Museum (Mall location) is closest to L’Enfant Plaza, with Smithsonian also nearby. Museum guidance pages commonly state L’Enfant Plaza as the nearest, serving Yellow, Green, Blue, Orange, and Silver.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: WebSurfer, find the closest Metro station to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF at DCA.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF is on the grounds of Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. The closest Metro station is National Airport (often listed as Reagan National Airport), served by Yellow and Blue Lines.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: WebSurfer, please identify the Metro station closest to Cleveland Elementary School in Washington, DC (the DCPS campus at 1825 8th St NW).

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Cleveland Elementary School (1825 8th St NW) is closest to Shaw–Howard University station on the Green/Yellow lines. Mount Vernon Square is also nearby but slightly farther; Shaw–Howard is typically cited as the nearest.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: FileSurfer, check if we have a local 2022 WMATA system map file we can reference.

history.name: FileSurfer
history.content: No local WMATA map files found. Recommend relying on the web results and station lists provided by WebSurfer.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Assistant, using the 2022 WMATA line configuration, count the number of stations between Shaw–Howard University (closest to Cleveland Elementary) and National Airport, staying on the Yellow Line and not changing lines. Provide the integer.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: On the Yellow Line southbound from Shaw–Howard University: Shaw–Howard → Mount Vernon Square → Gallery Place → Archives → L’Enfant Plaza → Pentagon → Pentagon City → Crystal City → National Airport. Counting the moves between Shaw–Howard and National Airport yields 8 stations away. Preliminary count: 8.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: WebSurfer, re-verify the Yellow Line northbound service in 2022 and list the Yellow Line stations from National Airport up through downtown to any northern terminus. I need absolute certainty; please confirm whether Yellow reached Shaw–Howard without transfers. Repeat the check thoroughly.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: WMATA service references from 2022 indicate Yellow Line regularly terminated at Mount Vernon Square (with extensions to Fort Totten not in all service patterns). Without changing lines, Yellow does not continue beyond Mount Vernon Square to Shaw–Howard in the typical schedule. From National Airport north on Yellow: National Airport → Crystal City → Pentagon City → Pentagon → L’Enfant Plaza → Archives → Gallery Place → Mount Vernon Square. That is 7 stops to Mount Vernon Square on Yellow.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Given the re-verification that Yellow typically ends at Mount Vernon Square and does not reach Shaw–Howard without a line change, the closest Yellow station to Cleveland Elementary would be Mount Vernon Square. Without changing lines, from National Airport to Mount Vernon Square is 7 stations. Final answer: 7.

mistake_reason: After the Assistant produced the correct count of 8, the orchestrator unnecessarily repeated the exact verification step, demanding absolute certainty and re-running the same Yellow Line service lookup. This step repetition led to discarding the valid result and adopting a truncated service interpretation (terminus at Mount Vernon Square), causing the team to miscount and output 7 instead of 8. This aligns with FM-1.3: repeating previously completed steps without parameter changes, creating a circular re-check that introduced error.
